name: Describe Custom Object
summary: Shows one custom object type's full structure: fields, key fields, and relationships.
whenToUse: Before querying or writing an object's records — to learn its field API names and which fields can be used as keys.

path.name: apiName
path.label: Object API name
path.hint: The object type's API name (lowercase, e.g. car) — find it via List Custom Objects.

response.description: Object metadata: idField, dedupeFields, searchableFields, field list, relationships.
